title: Exceptions and logging

spans.text: Catch expected failures by their specific exception type; broad except blocks can hide programming bugs. logging records time and severity; show users a safe, clear message.

spans.code: No output at INFO level for the successful conversion; invalid input logs the exception.

spans.text: A specific exception handler handles an expected failure type.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Never write passwords, tokens, or personal data to logs.

spans.title: Warning
spans.text: Broad except Exception and especially bare except should not silently swallow failures.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
